definitions.pressure: Any standing defender within 2 yd at 20 Hz, starting 0.5 s, through release/sack/scramble. sack-anatomy.ts retains the 10 Hz tracking proxy.
definitions.attached: At least one geometrically close defender still in a block; free and attached durations can overlap.
definitions.compression: Mean longitudinal blocker displacement since first contact at release/sack/scramble, for blocks still attached at that instant.
definitions.interceptions: Observed predecessors and read/pressure flags, not a causal label for QB mistakes. These IDs refer to this guard panel, not the six-game film library.
